label: Possibly some concrete GOD_4 exists at the standpoint
term: possibly a concrete GOD_4 exists (case instance)
definition: GodPossiblyExistsAt σ m w is PossibleExistence m.ontic.frame (GodConcreteExists σ m) w: some world accessible from w has some x that is GOD_4, concrete and existing there. It is the only premise of the route that supplies concreteness and GOD_4-hood.
note: Possibility here is Kripke accessibility of the case profile's frame, not conceivability or Kantian real possibility. Open; the reverse possibility premise (an accessible world without a concrete GOD_4) is its recorded symmetric rival in NecessaryIfExistent.
